content: IOP/CiNii metadata for DOI 10.1088/0022-3719/13/4/016 confirms the article title 'Slater-Koster tables for f electrons', Journal of Physics C: Solid State Physics 13(4), pages 583-588, published 1980-02-10, authors K. Takegahara, Y. Aoki, and A. Yanase. Accessible abstract says f orbitals are represented by cubic harmonics and tables cover s-f, p-f, d-f, and f-f two-centre integrals. The full formula tables and ordering/sign convention were not extractable from the accessible HTML/PDF endpoint in this session.
